'''Seti Ashgad''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] engineer for [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] in the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], similar to his contemporary, [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]].

==Biography==
[[File:Seti.jpg|thumb|left|120px|Seti Ashgad, a senator and hyperdrive engineer in waning years of the Old Republic.]]
Ashgad was on the team that designed the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]]. Later, he used his connections to be elected [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] in the days of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was very ambitious, and it was believed he wanted to take [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] place as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], and not just manipulate the post. Shortly after he opposed the placement of [[Cam droid/Legends|cam droids]] in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|20.65 BBY]], he disappeared, causing some distress for [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]].

He was secretly sent to a prison on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] by Palpatine, but filled the power void created by [[Beldorion]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] failure to maintain his rule over the planet's populace. 

Years later following the fall of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Ashgad, posing as his son with the same name, would reappear in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]] and attempted to conquer [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by kidnapping [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], Bail's adoptive daughter, and releasing the [[Death Seed]] plague. [[Dzym]] helped maintain his youthful look by using his powers. Seti made a speech criticising the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to anger the oldcomers to his side. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Tsil]]s in a [[Needle fighter|CCIR Needle]] fighting the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] above Nam Chorios while on a ship trying to leave the system with [[Dzym]], the humanoid [[Droch/Legends|Droch]].

==Behind the scenes==
Ashgad was incorrectly called "Jeti Ashgad" in the article, ''The Emperor's Pawns''.
